title: PHYS-ENGINE-PUBLIC-02: Deliver the stable-stack public World acceptance milestone
body:
## What problem does this solve?

Parent #1179 aims at a reusable renderer-neutral rigid engine. Closed #1399 finished a bounded full-pair solver experiment but retained **NUMERICAL_NO_GO_WORLD**: ALIGNED failed resting drift/tilt and OFFSET/YAW escaped the finite floor. The public hinge path #1489 → #1490 cannot close stable contacts or joint/contact composition. The roadmap needs a finite public stable-stack acceptance checkpoint, rather than another indefinitely detached diagnostic chain.

## Describe your solution

**PLANNED, blocked on a justified stable-contact law and actual physical GO.** Existing Physics owner owns the contract and any separately frozen Physics implementation; sole Integration retains adoption. This card does not choose or authorize an unreviewed solver law.

### First product milestone

A developer constructs the original floor plus eight dynamic boxes through the package's public createPhysicsWorld and runs the original ALIGNED, OFFSET and YAW inputs for 1200 steps / 10 seconds without a private factory or fixture-ID recognition. Preserve the exact SI inputs and original #1185/#1399 quality gates. Public admission alone is not success.

### Required decision before implementation

1. Reuse #1399's immutable first-failure evidence. Identify the smallest proposed law change addressing resting angular support, discrete gap and position/lever-arm consistency; state why it addresses the recorded failure.
2. Freeze exact law, admission/composition scope, modules, source/provider/emitted provenance, independent reference, accepted/refused behavior, total calls/work/storage limits and failure stop before any new execution. No automatic open-ended tuning or repeated cap increments.
3. If no justified candidate exists, record BLOCKED and the missing decision here. Any necessary implementation child must link back to this public exit gate; do not treat a child's experimental closure as this card's acceptance.
4. Preserve existing small-profile receipts and public refusals until a new profile is actually qualified. General connected joint networks, CCD and large-mode combinations remain excluded unless independently admitted.

### Public acceptance, not yet measured

- [ ] All three original worlds complete 1200 accepted steps with finite state, unchanged quaternion/bounds criteria and independent all-pair geometry
- [ ] Peak penetration ≤2 mm; final two seconds vertical drift ≤5 mm, horizontal drift ≤1 cm, linear/angular speed ≤0.02 m/s and rad/s, upright tilt ≤1 degree, and no finite-floor escape, exactly as the original selected contract defines
- [ ] Actual source, repeat and genuine compiled public consumers, copied outputs, deterministic selected identity mapping, meaningful refusal/state retention, lifecycle and disposal; retain first failures
- [ ] Any refinement/performance gate remains conditional on base physical GO and a separately frozen bounded budget; report unrun results honestly
- [ ] Exact Integration adoption and a runnable existing-host/Manual entry with accepted-versus-displayed state, Play/Pause/one step/Reset, explicit SI conversion, refusal retention, recovery and cleanup; reuse the existing Viewer route only after its capacity/identity contract is verified
- [ ] Publish the bounded supported/refused matrix and link evidence back to #1179; do not close full #1179/#660 or claim Box3D parity

## Any alternatives?

#1185–#1399 already cover historical private contact experiments; #820/#769 cover smaller historical rest profiles. Do not reopen or overwrite their results. #1489/#1490 handle disjoint hinges, not stable box contacts. A screenshot or saved playback is insufficient evidence for this live public-world milestone.

## Additional context

Source evidence: [#1399 current result](https://github.com/barocss/barocss/issues/1399), [original #1185 gates](https://github.com/barocss/barocss/issues/1185), [roadmap review](https://github.com/barocss/barocss/issues/1179#issuecomment-6109909454), [canonical roadmap](https://github.com/barocss/barocss/wiki/Physics-Product-Roadmap). All-state PHYS-ENGINE and stable-World searches found the historical experiments but no open public stable-stack delivery acceptance card. No new test/model run is represented by this issue.

## Priority and delivery boundaries

WebGPU #1512 remains the highest global priority. Existing owner boundaries and holds remain unchanged; this planning card does not start an owner, authorize a runtime campaign, change source, merge, publish, or release. Integration alone adopts exact completed native changes. Keep native result, exact adoption, current #674/#1254 integration validation and publication separate.

---

## 2026-10-13 next implementation contract — candidate, NOT qualified

Owner request: continue Physics development, starting with this existing stable-stack delivery card; avoid duplicate issues. Current status stays **BLOCKED on law selection / NOT RUN** until the Physics owner freezes an exact contract. No code, build, numerical execution, PR, merge or release is claimed by this addendum.

### Failure-directed hypothesis (not a numerical result)

#1399 qualified detached/full-pair *translation-only position* feasibility, but failed dynamic settling: ALIGNED drift/tilt, OFFSET/YAW finite-floor escape. Position nonpenetration alone is not a stable contact law. Candidate is a **rotational contact velocity solver with persistent per-feature impulses**, coupled to existing position feasibility, rather than further raising the position-row cap. This hypothesis addresses: (a) angular support via lever arms and inverse world inertia; (b) multi-frame normal/friction coherence using stable contact identities; (c) a strict separation of velocity impulses from position-only projections. It does **not** prove that the observed drift/escape will be fixed, and must be rejected if independent observations contradict it.

### Proposed bounded law to freeze before source edits

For each genuine fresh contact point p of bodies A/B, rA=p-xA, rB=p-xB, contact relative velocity vrel=(vB+omegaB×rB)-(vA+omegaA×rA). For unit normal n pointing A→B, Jn=invMassA+invMassB+n·[(invIA(rA×n))×rA+(invIB(rB×n))×rB]. Solve incremental nonnegative accumulated normal impulse λn=max(0, λn_old - (n·vrel + bias)/Jn); apply Δλn at ±n with linear and angular momentum updates. Bias (if any) must be explicitly defined from the frozen error/speed policy; do not insert penetration-based Baumgarte bias silently. Tangential accumulated impulse is constrained by |λt|<=μ λn with an explicitly frozen friction mixing rule. Restitution applies only under a frozen approach-speed threshold, not to resting contacts.

Positions are still corrected by one separately verified full-pair signed-geometry projection; record any momentum and contact-geometry inconsistency caused by translation-only correction, including net angular/linear drift. Persistent impulses may only reuse a stable, independently verified contact identity, and invalidate on changed features, separated pairs, conflicting normals or refused steps. Never retain stale contact as actual contact geometry. Strictly copy prior accepted state, caches and ordered cursor on any refusal/numeric failure; reject nonfinite/singular masses/inertia instead of clamping.

### Minimal experiment slice (proposal only)

- Begin with one body on a finite floor and a two-body stack to isolate spin/support and impulse caching, *before* the full eight-box experiment. Reuse existing native public limits; no new public admission on the strength of private reference tests.
- Freeze one representative #1399 first-failure archived state and independent all-pair/velocity/angular drift baseline; don't transform archived post-state into a new pre-state or overwrite immutable failures.
- Implement a new isolated Physics reference module/consumer only after complete source/fixture/threshold/expected error/independent reference/work budget freeze. Compare source/repeat/genuinely compiled runs. Preserve the old solver as control.
- One fixed iteration/work budget, one frozen impulse/cache policy and one bounded campaign; no unbounded parameter sweep or repeated iterations to force a pass. Explicitly report source commit and output provenance.
- Gate: immutable controls unchanged; new candidate must first keep the one-/two-body rest tests finite and show measured reduced drift/tilt without additional penetration. Only then evaluate the original three 1,200-step/10-second worlds against this issue's unchanged numeric gates. If it fails, retain first numerical failure and report NO_GO; do not silently widen limits.

### Remaining decisions owned by Physics before executable start

The exact contact-point schema/identity and source modules; world-inertia quaternion convention; normal tangent/friction-mix rules; bias and restitution threshold; dt and iteration budget; mass/inertia numeric floors and admission; rollback/cache ownership; exact fixtures, independent reference, and error precedence. Existing #1399 quality thresholds and #1179 public-world requirements are immutable. Integration alone owns adoption into develop. This is a **law candidate and bounded test plan**, not a selected/verified implementation or public capability.
